declarations.coverage: This declaration changes only remote GitHub configuration for the unambiguous github.com remote lutzseverino/repo-standards through its authored operations: canonical issue labels, the required PR metadata check, and squash-only merge settings. The empty project-content scope is intentional. The maintainer authorized this adoption, including these repeat-safe remote operations, and no repository identity or authorization question is open.

Repository Standards is one maintained root TypeScript and Node.js CLI package. package.json owns the build, CLI, bootstrap, system skills, packaging, tests and release commands, and pnpm-workspace.yaml declares no member packages, so no directory is a separately maintained Project with its own responsibility and development commands. The root Repository README belongs to repository-readme. The explained empty scope is complete.
